label: v361
changes: Build my timeline can read saved profile and vault documents, or a PDF / Word CV, and offer work, education and other moments for review before adding them.

Document imports retain source evidence, flag possible duplicates, preserve month/year precision and let you keep a moment without a date. A reading report identifies files or pages that could not be read.
Work is now available in family profiles, with career history, CVs and a place to link or upload work documents. Saved roles appear in the timeline under Work.
Fixed PDF reader loading and increased family CV uploads to 20 MB using file storage. Business CVs retain their existing record-level access and size limit.
